thread:
anya: Heads-up — saw sustained KV memory growth on gpu-3 for tenant=alpha during longctx runs (~50k tokens). Looks like residency is not decaying between sessions.
leon: Can you paste the pprof / alloc traces? Which process? (serving-runtime:kv_manager)
anya: pasted below. spans show many small allocations from slab_alloc in page_compactor.
```text
# pprof top
heap: 1.2GB
    400MB  slab_alloc
    300MB  kv_page
    200MB  kv_entry
...
# top_allocs by stack
slab_alloc -> page_walk -> kv_reserve  (high)
```
leon: Hmm fragmentation + lots of small resident pages. Did the eviction watermark move? any large contiguous free runs?
mika: I think this is the small-chunk allocator biting us. When tenants push long ctxs we pin many disjoint KV pages; compaction isn't coalescing because we only compact at full-page thresholds.
sam: Are quotas applied? current per-tenant kv_residency_limit is 1GB in prod YAML (snippet):
```yaml
tenants:
  alpha:
    kv_limit_bytes: 1073741824
```
ops-bot: Alert: tenant=alpha approached kv_limit (95%) on gpu-3 at 2026-03-10T14:12:05Z. Eviction triggered.
elena: If eviction is triggering but memory keeps growing, maybe reuse of freed fragments is broken. I saw a fix in PR#3421 that regressed reuse index wraparound.
jack: Repro: run longctx generator against alpha with seq=50k tokens. Local sim hits fragmentation after ~300 requests. Patch idea: increase page compaction frequency for tenants > 500MB and bump eviction granularity from 4KB -> 16KB.
anya: Proposed experiment:
- canary: eng-runtime/gpu-3 only
- change config: compaction threshold 0.6 -> 0.4, eviction_granularity=16KB
- collect: pprof, kv_residency histogram, tenant fairshare metrics
Timeline: start 2h from now, 4h run, roll back if tail latency > 2x or OOM risk.
leon: +1. If we see regression, rollback. Also add a hook to dump kv_free_list after compaction.
mika: I'll open the canary config and add tracing. tagging @sam for quota tweak approval :thumbsup:
sam: Approved. go ahead.
anya: launching in 10m. will post results.
